The '''Burning Wound''' was the name given to the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] rift that gave rise to [[the Scar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] between the [[Power Center cavern]] to the west and [[the Tomb]] to the east. Heat from the Burning Wound formed the scar by melting the [[Water/Legends|ice]] to the north and south, extending the ice canyon in those directions.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Burning Wound is a subzone of the Scar on the planet Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', dividing the Scar into a northern half, with an Imperial medcenter and path, and a southern half, with a Republic medcenter and a path.<ref name="TOR" />
